answer: Assign each new identity a low earning cap and raise it only after unrelated peers verify random samples of completed work against signed source records. Link accounts that reuse reviewers or artifacts and cap the whole cluster as one participant. A reviewer might audit a knoll survey against raw coordinates, trace a timber shipment to its signed inventory, or verify saffron batch data. To amplify rewards, an attacker must supply distinct evidence and independent histories, not merely generate keys.
